date.description: The receipt date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

total.description: The final total amount as a plain number, no currency symbol.

gst_number.description: The GST/GSTIN number if present, otherwise null. Never invent one.

category.description: The kind of receipt. Use 'other' if it fits none of the named types.

category_detail.description: If category is 'other', a short description of what it is. Otherwise null.
